bullets.id: Emas spot menutup pekan di sekitar $4.069,63, turun 0,43% pada Jumat setelah payroll Oktober melonjak 165.000, hampir tiga kali perkiraan 65.000. Meski begitu, emas dibuka pekan ini di $3.875,21 dan sempat menyentuh $4.147,02 pada Kamis, sehingga masih sekitar $194 di atas pembukaan pekan.
bullets.en: Spot gold ended the week near $4,069.63, down 0.43% on Friday after October payrolls jumped 165,000, nearly three times the 65,000 forecast. Even so, gold opened the week at $3,875.21 and touched $4,147.02 on Thursday, leaving it about $194 above the week’s open.

bullets.id: Survei mingguan Kitco terbelah: dari 13 analis Wall Street, 31% memperkirakan emas naik, 38% turun dan 31% mendatar. Investor ritel lebih optimistis: 68% dari 212 suara memperkirakan kenaikan. Yield 2 tahun naik sekitar 6 bp ke 4,53% setelah payroll, dan emas masih sekitar 27,4% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 dari Januari.
bullets.en: Kitco’s weekly survey is split: of 13 Wall Street analysts, 31% expect gold to rise, 38% expect a fall and 31% see it flat. Retail investors are more upbeat: 68% of 212 votes expect gains. The 2-year yield rose about 6 bp to 4.53% after payrolls, and gold is still about 27.4% below January’s $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: CPI Oktober rilis Selasa 10 November. Karena penutupan pemerintah 2025, BLS tidak akan menerbitkan inflasi tahunan untuk headline dan inti, hanya perubahan bulanan. Nowcast Cleveland Fed memperkirakan headline 0,24% dan inti 0,21% sebulan, sementara RBC memperkirakan keduanya 0,3%. PPI menyusul Jumat 13 November. Kitco mencatat support $4.022 lalu $3.992 dan resistance $4.089.
bullets.en: October CPI is out on Tuesday 10 November. Because of the 2025 government shutdown, BLS will not publish annual headline and core inflation, only monthly changes. The Cleveland Fed nowcast sees headline at 0.24% and core at 0.21% on the month, while RBC expects 0.3% for both. PPI follows on Friday 13 November. Kitco has support at $4,022 then $3,992 and resistance at $4,089.

bullets.id: Logam Mulia tidak memperbarui harga pada Minggu, sehingga Antam 1 gram tetap Rp2.545.000 dan buyback Rp2.350.000 (spread Rp195.000, sekitar 7,7%). Galeri24 tetap Rp2.507.000 (buyback Rp2.360.000) dan UBS Rp2.540.000 (buyback Rp2.334.000). Galeri24 masih Rp38.000 lebih murah dari Antam dengan spread sekitar 5,9%.
bullets.en: Logam Mulia did not update prices on Sunday, so Antam’s 1-gram price stays at Rp2,545,000 with buyback at Rp2,350,000 (a Rp195,000 spread, about 7.7%). Galeri24 is unchanged at Rp2,507,000 (buyback Rp2,360,000) and UBS at Rp2,540,000 (buyback Rp2,334,000). Galeri24 remains Rp38,000 cheaper than Antam, with a spread of about 5.9%.
